items.label: SK Hynix press release: "Behind AI's Rapid Growth Lies Memory" - SK hynix Shares (09-28-2026)
items.signal_prefix: SK hynix and TSMC carried out a collaboration that validated

set.signal: SK hynix and TSMC carried out a collaboration that validated HBM5 on the basis of TSMC's CoWoS, with SK hynix's Package Development organization and TSMC carrying out validation together from the earliest stages. SK hynix's 12-layer 36GB HBM4 and 96GB SOCAMM2 are mounted on NVIDIA's Vera Rubin superchip (the HBM4 integrated directly around the Rubin GPU core; SOCAMM2 as the main system memory for the Vera CPU). Its next-generation HBM lineup shown alongside: 12-layer 48GB HBM4E, 16-layer 48GB HBM4 and 12-layer 36GB HBM3E, plus a 192GB SOCAMM2.

items.why: Drop the award reference (awards are not captured); keep the HBM5/CoWoS validation fact and state the Vera Rubin HBM4/SOCAMM2 roles as the release describes them rather than as a booth display
